chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
He is questioned in his grave only the one who has made faith pure and made disbelief pure; and as for what is besides that, he is diverted from it.
ai.seo_question: Who is questioned in the grave according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the grave interrogation is reserved for those with definitive, unambiguous faith or disbelief, excluding those in a state of ambiguity or intermediate standing (like the Mu'allat). This distinction highlights the divine mercy in sparing the uncertain from the rigorous trial of the grave, a concept central to Shia eschatology regarding the fate of the 'intermediate' souls.
